prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: TravelHub destination artwork, Milano alternative 02
Primary request: Create a second, clearly different pastel travel illustration of Milano with the Duomo di Milano as the unmistakable main landmark.
Scene/backdrop: View from beneath the elegant stone-and-glass entrance arcade of the Galleria Vittorio Emanuele II looking outward into Piazza del Duomo. The arch frames the cathedral; the Duomo's pale marble façade, dense Gothic pinnacles and spires remain fully visible and architecturally recognizable.
Subject: The Duomo is the brightest focal point and occupies at least half of the visible exterior scene. The Galleria arch acts only as a dark, elegant foreground frame.
Style/medium: Soft pastel gouache vintage travel-poster illustration, delicate paper grain, painterly but architecturally legible, matching the existing collection.
Composition/framing: Wide 2.1:1 landscape; dramatic framed perspective through the arcade; a few tiny pedestrians for scale; strong visual path from mosaic floor to the cathedral.
Lighting/mood: Early morning golden light entering the piazza, calm, refined and romantic.
Color palette: Warm ivory marble, dusty blush and apricot light, muted slate blue shadows, touches of antique gold and sage.
Constraints: Original composition; Duomo must dominate and remain recognizable at small card size; no text, logos, branding, watermark or border.
Avoid: repeating the previous straight-on open-piazza composition, generic Italian streets, oversized people, modern skyscrapers, fantasy Gothic forms, making the arcade the subject, black blueprint line art, photorealism.
